access: Author-uploaded text, attributed to Nirakar Bhol, 3 March 2026. Methods and Table 1 read in HTML extraction; PDF retrieval failed. No visual verification claimed.
methods: 2022–23 fieldwork; six holding-size categories; villages treated as replicates. Diversity measured at species level. Returns calculated from yields and specified prices, less seed and labour costs.
assessment: Reviewed methods do not establish sampled households as Dongria Kondh. Niyamgiri attribution needs geographic reconciliation. Calculated returns are not verified household receipts; species diversity does not establish cultivar or seed provenance.
decision: Hold Dongria-specific claims. Seek participant identification, village-location reconciliation and accession records. No numerical findings adopted.
